# N4V FOR WEBI

> N4V FOR WEBI is a suite of extensions for SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (WebI), published by Need4Viz SAS, a Paris-based SAP Build Partner. It adds interactive charts, maps, AI and HTML5 publishing on top of existing Web Intelligence reports. No migration. No code.

Key facts:
- Publisher: Need4Viz SAS, Paris, France. Contact: contact@need4viz.com
- Category: extension suite for SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (not a replacement BI platform)
- Axes: Simplify, Enhance, Facilitate
- Modules: N4V Widgets (60+ interactive chart types), N4V Maps (GIS and cartography), N4V Publisher (HTML5 export), N4V Intelligence (AI and natural-language queries)
- Works with the existing BusinessObjects platform, universes and security; no migration, no custom code
- SAP and BusinessObjects are trademarks of SAP SE; Need4Viz is not affiliated with SAP SE
